analysis.summary: Today's tech and business headlines highlight several significant trends. In the realm of cybersecurity, two teenagers were arrested for a cyber-attack on a nursery chain (BBC Technology). Meanwhile, AI advancements are causing concern among YouTube creators, with MrBeast expressing fear about its implications (BBC Technology). On the business front, Snapchat users are upset over upcoming fees for storing old photos and videos (BBC Technology), while Gold prices surged past $4,000 an ounce amid uncertainty (BBC Business). Additionally, there's a looming crisis in UK steel industry due to EU tariff hikes (BBC Business). In the world of technology startups, Charles Schwab backed Singapore’s Qapita, and Revolut is challenging Indian banks with competitive forex fees (TechCrunch). On the legal front, a debate emerged on deepfaking deceased individuals (TechCrunch). Lastly, Tesla expanded its lineup with standard-range Model 3 and Y (Ars Technica), and Firefox introduced profiles for separate browsing sessions (The Verge).
